changes: Any change after this commit is a new version and is logged as a trial.

scope.instrument: near-month futures of a universe underlying; futures only, no option trades
scope.units: return terms, share of notional; no lots, no lot-based sizing (lots before 2024-07-08 are UNVERIFIED)
scope.data: research loader, base tables only (base_futures, base_fo_summary)

periods.locked: 2025-01-01 onward: not read by this task

scope.excluded_features: no implied-vol or put-call parity features

universe.primary: U1 of universes_v1.json; first year 2011 (no prior-year ranking in 2010)
universe.flagged_links: only symbol-map links with status mapped and flags 'none' join two symbols into a series for ranking. Flagged links (DCB->DCBBANK, MAX->MFSL and the dates-only links) stay separate series
universe.symbol_links_inside_a_trade: never crossed: a trade holds one contract of one symbol; if the symbol changes before the exit there is no exit row and no trade
universe.membership: member on the entry session, decided from rows public at that session (universes_v1.json)

trade.signal_time: after the close of session D, using only data with known_from on or before the next session
trade.entry: open of the first session after D
trade.exit: close of session D + h (h = 1 enters and exits in the same session; the trade spans h sessions)
trade.contract_and_roll: at D, the nearest listed expiry with at least ceil(1.4 h) + 4 calendar days left. One contract is held from entry to exit, so no roll happens inside a trade and a roll gap can never be profit or loss. Daily returns for features are close-to-close on the one contract that was nearest at the previous session
trade.no_fill: no trade if the contract has no entry row, a non-positive open or zero contracts at entry, or no exit row. Dropped, never replaced
trade.untraded_exit: if zero contracts traded on the exit session, the exit is NSE's settle price
trade.archive_holes: 2013-10-09 and 2021-03-30 count as sessions; a trade entering or exiting on one has no price and is not taken
trade.win: net return after all costs strictly above 0. Exactly 0 is not a win
trade.one_open_trade: one per underlying. Oldest first: a signal is taken only if its entry is after the open trade's exit. Signals during an open trade are ignored, not queued

splits_and_bonuses.rule: prices are never adjusted. A trade is not taken if a split or bonus footprint falls after its entry and on or before its exit. Footprint: on one contract, session-to-session close ratio p <= 0.8 or p >= 1.25, and p x open-interest ratio within 0.8-1.25. Both directions, decided without reference to the trade's result. Those sessions are also empty in the daily return series
splits_and_bonuses.measured_on_development: 80 of 89 NSE-listed split or bonus moves in the 2015-2022 list are caught; 115 of the 195 footprints in 2015-2022 are not in that list (it holds only moves over 5 sigma with a matching action). Coverage of corporate actions before 2015 is UNVERIFIED. Missed events remain in the data
splits_and_bonuses.worst_gross_trade_on_development: -87.3% at h = 10, consistent with a missed event; not removed

costs.label: cost model unverified
costs.source: tradingagents/analytics/costs.py, futures rates as of 2026-10-23, applied to all history; not checked against a contract note
costs.brokerage: Rs 20 per order, as a share of an ASSUMPTION reference notional of Rs 10,00,000 per order

targets.T1: sign of the net return, per horizon, long and short sides
targets.T2: net return magnitude, per horizon, long and short sides
targets.T3: forward realized volatility: root mean square of daily returns over sessions D+1 to D+h. Risk use only, not direction
targets.leak_rule: a label for D uses no data after D + h; a feature for D uses no data after D

minimum_move.rule: skip a trade whose ex-ante expected |move| is below 2 x its round-trip cost at 1.5x costs. Expected |move| = 0.8 x std of the last 20 daily returns x sqrt(h), known at the close of D; a symbol with under 20 returns has none and is skipped
minimum_move.how_chosen: from cost arithmetic, not results: a trade expected to move less than twice its cost has no room to pay for itself. Checked on development data only

gate.applies_to: a model on the clean forward holdout from 2026-10-27, all items at 1.5x costs. Failing any item is a FAIL
gate.a: at least 100 settled trades (target 150), counted once per signal. Same-date signals are clustered. The gate uses the effective count: N / (1 + (m0 - 1) rho), rho = ANOVA intra-date correlation of net returns floored at 0, m0 = the ANOVA average cluster size. The raw count is also reported
gate.c: one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05 on effective counts (wins and n rounded), null = the measured win rate of the same structure with a random direction on the same trades: the mean of (long wins + short wins) / 2
gate.d: net expectancy per trade > 0 and the lower bound of a block-bootstrap 95% interval > 0 (whole signal dates, block = h dates, 2000 draws)

e.rule: net expectancy above each baseline. None may be added later
e.garch_risk_scaled: always long, weight = 30% annual (ASSUMPTION) / GARCH(1,1) h-session annualised forecast known at D, capped at 2; costs scale with the weight. Student-t, constant mean, refit every 63 sessions, expanding window, first forecast after the module's minimum training length

gate.f: net expectancy on U2 has the same sign as on U1

g.rule: walk-forward on the folds below, all at 1.5x costs: (i) net expectancy > 0 in at least 70% of folds; (ii) no fold's net expectancy is below -X_h% of notional per trade; (iii) every fold has at least 100 effective trades; a fold below that is a FAIL, not skipped
g.x_formula: X_h = 0.50% x sqrt(h/10), rescaled in proportion to measured / assumed SD where they differ by more than 25%

sd_measurement.data: U1, gross trade returns at each horizon, every eligible signal, exits on or before 2022-12-31; no later data used
sd_measurement.note: Missed splits or bonuses remain in the data and raise these SDs. h = 1 is just under the 25% line and is not rescaled

walk_forward.purge_and_embargo: training excludes trades exiting within h sessions before a test fold, and entries within h sessions after an earlier test fold
walk_forward.tuning: inside development folds only. The 2023-2024 fold is validation: used once per frozen model spec
walk_forward.why_two_year_folds: chosen before any run so a fold can plausibly hold 100 effective trades; whether it does is measured, and a shortfall is a FAIL

multiple_testing.trial_counter: every distinct model spec, horizon, universe, target and threshold is a trial in the trial log; the count is reported beside every result
multiple_testing.correction: Bonferroni: a p-value counts as significant in development or validation only below 0.05 / N, N = the current trial count

forward_registry: append-only, hash-chained; signal, timestamp, model spec hash, universe, horizon, written before the entry session opens (09:15 IST). A trade not in the registry before entry does not count. Missed days are recorded as missed, never backfilled
